reports.title: KANZHUN LIMITED Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company currently expects its total revenues to be between RMB2.19 billion and RMB2.23 billion, representing a year-on-year increase of 5.3% to 7.3%. This forecast reflects the Company’s current views on the market and operational conditions in China, which are subject to change and cannot be predicted with reasonable accuracy as of the date hereof.
